verdict.rationale: The evidence documents only single-step CLI operations: --convert-to batch conversion and --print-to-file. There is no built-in multi-step job definition, pipeline, or watched-folder workflow that chains convert, optimize, and deliver. Macros applied on open and headless UNO API control are developer building blocks for constructing such a chain, and running LibreOffice in Docker is a user-side workaround; neither counts toward this story.
